subject: 404 error when deploying a .Rmd with Shiny to shinyapps.io

messages.author: 1667ac6354bdba89
messages.subject: 404 error when deploying a .Rmd with Shiny to shinyapps.io
parts:
Hello :)

Are .Rmd with Shiny apps inculded supported by shinyapps.io?  I have tried to publish one but I get a 404 Not Found at the URL of the application.

The .Rmd document does include a call to an API on startup, that may timeout - could that be an issue?  It works ok locally, but it pulls in from a backup .RData file if the API is unavailable.

Yours sincerely,
Mark
